source: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance (ESA Copernicus), via Element 84 Earth Search on AWS open data
encoding: sRGB-encoded surface reflectance (red B04, green B03, blue B02), one pixel per pack cell, north up
waterRule: white where the NDWI (green B03 - near infrared B08) / (B03 + B08) > 0
cloudRule: a cell takes the first scene whose classification (SCL) shows the ground (not cloud, cirrus or cloud shadow) in at least half its pixels; the first scene of each tile, then the fill scenes, clearest first, for land cells
